court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Lovel Jitendra Jain And Anr vs Smriti Jain And Anr

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Lovel Jitendra Jain, Jitendra Jain, Sushma Jitendra Jain (husband, wife, mother-in-law and father-in-law)
parties.respondent_defendant: Smriti Jain, The State of Maharashtra (wife, original complainant and state)

facts_of_case: The applicants seek quashing of the FIR registered with the Borivali Police Station, Mumbai. The parties have amicably settled their dispute. The applicant No.1 is the husband of respondent No.1 and the applicant Nos. 2 and 3 are the mother-in-law and father-in-law of respondent No.1.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can settle their disputes amicably and seek quashing of FIR.
legal_principles.held: The parties have amicably settled their dispute.

legal_principles.principle: Mutual consent is a ground for dissolution of marriage.
legal_principles.held: The parties have filed a Petition seeking dissolution of their marriage by mutual consent under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act.

outcome.final_order: The FIR is quashed on the premise that the parties have amicably settled their dispute.
